summary: Maps a session type id a1 (0-7) to a display string. When a2 is non-zero the short-name string table is used; when a2 is zero the long-name table is used. Session type 5/6/7 map to the same strings in both tables (Qualify, Warmup, Race). Out-of-range ids fall through to the "Unknown" string.

operations.description: Branch on flag a2 selects the short-name switch table (a2 non-zero) or the long-name switch table (a2 zero); both switch bodies are compiled in the function.
Switch on session type id a1; the long-name cases dispatch through jump table jpt_42CE39 and the short-name cases through jump table jpt_42CE63.
a1 == 5: return aQualify from the shared label reached by both tables.
a1 == 6: return aWarmup from the shared label reached by both tables.
a1 == 7: return aRace_0 from the shared label reached by both tables.
Default case: return aUnknown for out-of-range session type ids.
Return the selected session type name string to the caller.
Consumed by Steward_Restart, sub_4FE350, and WeatherConditionsFileWriter for session type name display; the exact roles of the callers are outside this function's scope.
